info.name: Absence
info.summary: Vacation and sick-leave management for your whole company
info.description:
Absence is a self-service leave-management app: employees apply for vacation, line managers approve or decline, and HR gets a company-wide overview with statistics and exports.
Everything stays on your own server — who is off, who is sick and why they asked is never replicated to a third party, and there is no per-seat licence. There is also no second org chart to maintain: employees are your Nextcloud users, HR is a Nextcloud group, and line managers come from the `manager` account property your LDAP or Active Directory already fills in.
**For employees**
* 🌴 Apply for annual, sick, unpaid or special leave — or any leave type you define, with your own colours and rules * ⚖️ Full balance tracking: entitlement, used, pending, remaining and carry-over * 🗓️ The working-day count is prefilled from your availability and your country's public holidays — and stays editable * 👥 See which colleagues are already off while you are still choosing the dates * ⏳ A "next break" countdown, animated balance rings and monthly charts on a single screen
**For line managers**
* ✅ Approve in one click straight from the notification, without opening the app * 🔍 Coverage warnings when approving would leave the team short-staffed * ⚠️ Short-notice warnings when leave starts sooner than your company expects * 📆 A Gantt-style team timeline of who is off this month * ⏰ Requests you miss are reminded, then automatically escalated to HR
**For HR**
* 🩺 Record sick leave — or any absence — directly, with no approval step * 🧾 Correct or cancel any absence; cancelled records are kept for the audit trail * 📊 Company-wide balances, statistics, a sick-leave overview and a who's-off timeline * 👤 Set entitlements per employee or in bulk for an entire group * 📤 CSV export of requests and balances for payroll
**For administrators**
* ⚙️ Declarative admin settings: HR group, entitlements, escalation window, carry-over policy, notice period and coverage threshold * 📅 Approved leave synced to Nextcloud Calendar (personal and shared team calendar), with configurable type visibility * 🔔 Notifications, email and Activity for every step — quoting what people actually wrote, so nobody has to open the app to find out * 🔒 Strict server-side permissions, rate limiting and GDPR deletion handling * 📝 An always-on audit log in `nextcloud.log`, written regardless of your log level
Full days only for now (no half-days), CSV export only, and deliberately no payroll, time-tracking or shift-planning — this app manages leave and does that one thing properly. Every rule and design decision is documented in the [specification](https://github.com/nextcloud/absence/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md).
info.author: Frank Karlitschek
